explanation: Recursively match the regex prefix, trying repetition lengths for star and literal/dot matches otherwise. Anchors restrict the allowed start or end; without a start anchor, try each text suffix. This version is not memoized.
timeComplexity: Exponential worst case; O((n+1)(n+m)·2^(n+m)) is a conservative bound
